ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white field; one dark vertical pigmentation streak at the median notch; dark perimeter banding along the trailing edge; two small, low-intensity circular spots located on the right lobe medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing boundary with peak amplitudes of 3-7 pixels occurring at semi-regular intervals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast yellowish-white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Encrusting biological growth (barnacle clusters) present at both lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical dark pigmentation mark centered directly below the median notch.
